decisions.reason: The Definition allowed arbitrary positive-rank attaching triples, whereas its triangle supplier requires a small pointed triple-free representative. At a constant triangle du=0, so varying J gives no parameter derivative and cannot supply the missing transversality. Added precisely the supplier's curve choice, with generator, Spin-c and strict-admissibility transport, before choosing regular ends. Rank zero remains the matching point model. This supplies the actual prerequisite without changing the cobordism, coefficient ring, auxiliary cycles or AC_omega boundary.

The fixed-sector definition makes the first target CFL(Y_mid,K_mid,s1|Y_mid) and the second source CFL(Y_mid,K_mid,s2|Y_mid). Without equality these are different objects, so an empty extension sum does not type their composite. Required matching boundary restrictions and the natural intermediate-diagram identification, and explicitly excluded incompatible-sector compositions. The extension sum and product specialization for admissible compositions are retained.

The linked generic-movie definition requires knot endpoints, while this Definition accepts arbitrary oriented links and empty frames. The existing lem-smooth-link-cobordisms-admit-finite-generic-movies supplies exactly the needed finite link movie with collars, prescribed endpoints and actual trace. Added it directly to deps and Definition references, retaining the knot definition as a specialization. Corrected the contract's empty-case row, which wrongly declared nonempty knot ends. The Definition itself and its claim strength are unchanged. This is a citation-interface defect: the needed general supplier already exists in the transitive prerequisites, so no new mathematical construction is required.

Fact F7 incorrectly attributed formal crossing cubes to the open-category definition, which supplies only surfaces, grading and planar totalization. The already declared third-Reidemeister supplier explicitly specifies the raw signed cubes, so no prerequisite is mathematically missing. Corrected F7 to cite that actual interface and wrote the adjacent-crossing vertex-sign calculation in proof 3.1. The local retractions, simplicity argument, five Morse identities and integral Frobenius evaluation retain their original scope.
